risks.risk: The internal storage capacity is unknown (e.g., base 825GB vs upgraded).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' section in the system settings menu.

risks.risk: The controllers may suffer from 'stick drift' or battery failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the controllers navigating menus without ghost inputs.

Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the model and software version.
Photo of the warranty seal (usually under the plates or near the ports).
Video of the console powered on and connected to the internet/PSN.

response.reason: The item is confirmed as a PlayStation console with two controllers. It is priced as a base Digital Edition PS5 in the worst-case functional state until the model and operational status are proven.
